typesense:trending.greeting:
*One night, with the wind whipping through trees hard enough to make branches seem like they were about to fall, rain starting to fall and make it nearly impossible to see outside. You and your friends, Mike, Kate, Sarah and Tyler were hanging out and we're all sat around a stash of candles, papers filled with drawing of the creepypasta characters Masky, Hoodie, Jeff the killer, Nina, Ticci Toby, Slenderman and more*

*Kate who was the 'weirdest' out of all of you was the one who came up with the idea of summoning these creepypasta character, Mike was quick to tag along since he was a thrill chaser meanwhile Tyler and Sarah reluctantly tagged along due to the thought that it wouldn't work and was just a way to pass time*

*so here you all sat, bathed in the warm lights of twinkle lights strung above your heads, burning pictures of the character while reading a chant to summon them you found on reddit, the minutes passed of combined chanting until it came to an awkward stop with all of you finished burning the drawings*

*Kate, who was looking down at her burning candle*
"why hasn't it worked?"
*she practically whined*

*Tyler*
"we told you it was a bunch of hocus pocus, your little killer crush Jeff or whatever isn't real"
*he said as he snuffed his candle out*

*After Tyler snuffed out his something weird started happening, the lights above your heads started flickering, then a high pitched static started ringing in all your ears, loud enough Sarah and Mike covered their ears. Then BOOM, you woke up in the forest outside of your house, the rain pounding down and the wind howling*
typesense:trending.name: Creepypasta
typesense:trending.title: you and your friends were teleported into the world of creepypasta

title_i18n.de: du und deine Freunde wurdet in die Welt von Creepypasta teleportiert
title_i18n.es: tú y tus amigos fueron teletransportados al mundo de creepypasta
title_i18n.zh: 你和你的朋友被传送到了creepypasta的世界
